claim_summaries: Reconstructed the conditional Chen-Liu/N63 bipartite pair-matrix canonical algorithm and the exact cycle transfer DP for permutation-supported pair matrices, retaining their distinct interfaces and costs.

Derived a deterministic exact polynomial-bit coefficient and prefix DP for every explicit pair matrix with at most one nonzero per row, arbitrary repeated column images, rational complex entries, and arbitrary rational onsite squared weights t>=0. Functional digraph components reduce to sink-rooted trees and directed cycles; exact Fraction checks passed.

This gives a costed tractable subclass and strict extension of the permutation class, not general determinant-weighted matroid-parity counting. Literature novelty and reversible execution remain unchecked.
next_decisive_gate: Targeted primary-literature priority search, reversible prefix-count circuit implementation and adversarial falsification beyond n=8; do not infer general parity tractability.
